description:
🔴 ACTS FOR THE USER: call it only after the user has explicitly agreed to this exact action (what, where, when, who) — never on your own judgement.
For a service whose business’s card shows a `book` action with method `connected` and no `book` in its
`cannot` (a door the platform refuses for this account is marked there, with the reason, at every sync). Take a `start_at`
from check_availability (slots) and the platform books it for the named customer; the answer is the
platform’s own status (created = on the calendar awaiting confirmation · confirmed · declined). A time
the platform does not offer is an `unavailable` error and nothing is booked. Idempotent by
`idempotency_key` like place_order. Get the user’s explicit yes first.
Follow the server instructions «HOW TO USE THE SUVERSE CATALOG»: results are candidates, not proof; keep reading, quoting, requesting and ordering separate; nothing is sent to an owner, booked, ordered or paid without the user’s permission.

email.description: the buyer’s e-mail: the platform sends the checkout link and the receipt there (for a booking; NOT asked for an order on Shopify or Square, whose checkout asks the buyer)

name.description: the buyer’s name (required for a booking)

phone.description: the buyer’s telephone with country code

start_at.description: ISO date-time with an offset, as check_availability gave it

variant_id.description: the service variation when the card lists several

name: book_slot
title: Book a slot in the business’s own calendar (Square Appointments)
